projectDescription: An unofficial Android port of the visual novel "Doki Doki Literature Club!" built on the Ren'Py engine, packaging the full game as a native Android APK.
keyFeatures: Full DDLC game playable on Android devices
Landscape (sensorLandscape) orientation lock for proper aspect ratio
Fixed dialog box sizing for Android 1920x1080 screens
Fixed .chr file handling for the secret menu easter egg
Singleton instance guard to prevent multiple game processes
Custom keymap tweaks for touch screens (mouseup_3 hide-windows binding)
Built with Ren'Py Android Packaging Tools (RAPT)
publicApiSurface: .android.json — Android build configuration (package, version, orientation, permissions)
game/options.rpy — Ren'Py config overrides (autosave, save directory, build archives)
game/definitions.rpy — Python helpers: delete_character(), restore_character(), restore_all_characters(), check_if_exist(), delete_all_saves()
game/gui.rpy — GUI constants (screen resolution 1280x720, textbox/namebox sizing)
game/python-packages/singleton.py — SingleInstance lock to prevent concurrent game processes
rapt/ — Ren'Py Android Packaging Tools templates and config
